# Synapgeek

> Synapgeek is an independent French mobile game studio (Synapgeek SAS, based in Frontenas, France) that designs and publishes Cerebrum, a brain-training puzzle game app for iOS and Android.

Synapgeek est un studio indépendant français de jeux mobiles (Synapgeek SAS, basé à Frontenas, dans le Rhône), éditeur de Cerebrum, une application de jeux de puzzle disponible sur iOS et Android.

## About Cerebrum

- Cerebrum combines six puzzle games in one app: Sudoku, Crossword, Word Search, Cross Math, Trace, and Maze.
- Each game offers multiple difficulty levels, daily challenges, and level-by-level progression.
- Cerebrum is free to download and play on the App Store and Google Play, with optional in-app purchases (virtual currency, themed Crossword and Word Search packs) and an optional Premium subscription.
- All games, including daily challenges, can be played offline without an internet connection; a connection is needed to sync progress, view leaderboards, purchase, sign in, and show ads.
- Cerebrum works without creating an account (anonymous session); players can optionally sign in with Apple, Google, or Facebook to sync progress across devices.
- Available in French and English, on iPhone and iPad (iOS 17+) and on Android (Android 8.0+), portrait mode.
